preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'a-z?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S contains only small case English letters and '?'.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is not possible to make the string S a palindrome, otherwise it is the sum of differences of adjacent characters in the resulting palindromic string.
